findings.summary: Menu and management result counts update on every search keystroke, which can create frequent live announcements.
findings.fix: Keep visual filtering immediate, but debounce the live result announcement until input pauses or announce only the settled count.
findings.evidence: Both search views update their live result counts on each input change.

passed: Homepage Add to Cart uses the shared cart handler and provides a success notice without a competing cart-count live announcement.
Menu search describes the current result count, including after category navigation.
